cover.title: They were told: pack for 3 days

lines.text: A whole city... left in one afternoon.
Pripyat, Ukraine. Built in 1970 for the workers of the Chernobyl nuclear plant. Nearly fifty thousand people lived here.
April 26th, 1986. Reactor number four exploded, about three kilometres away.
For more than a day, life went on. Then, on the afternoon of April 27th, the buses came.
Residents were told to pack for three days. They never came back.
The Ferris wheel was supposed to open on May first, for the holiday. It never officially turned.
The bumper cars are still where they stopped.
If you had to pack for three days... and never came back... what would you take? Comment it, partner.
